text:
Kevin (Billing): FYI we have a 52% GPU cost spike on the current billing cycle vs last — showing $68k so far. Need attribution; looks like a mix of untagged VMs and a new test pool. Anyone else seeing this?
infra-bot: ALERT: gpu-usage anomaly detected in project "rl-experiments-prod" — 49% increase in GPU hours. Case: #anomaly-1721. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/12345/reports (automated)
Maria (Finance): Oof. Can you paste the BigQuery export query / top-level breakdown you used? We need per-project + label attribution for chargeback and to draft a budget shift request.
Ajay (Ops): Ran a quick scan and shared results: https://short.link/recon-results — tl;dr: many instances launched under project "platform-qa" with no billing labels. Also seeing batch jobs from "embed-service" using GPUs with preemptible flag turned off (costly).
Leah (Platform): We did spin up a Dedicated GPU pool for a private beta last week — that should live in "dedicated-pool" project and be tagged. I'll check whether devs accidentally used the prod pool or created VMs in the wrong project.
Kevin (Billing): Maria — can you approve moving $20k from the "experimental" budget to cover this month's shortfall? Need procurement sign-off to avoid overage alerts.
Maria (Finance): Not yet. Need the recon artifact showing exact owners. If it's untagged infra, we should attribute ~80% back to Platform and ~20% to RL experiments, but need confirmation. Ping @Leah and cc @Ajay for ETA.
Ajay (Ops): Reconciliation ETA: EOD. Quick BigQuery snippet I used for initial breakdown:
```sql
SELECT
  project_id,
  labels.key AS label_key,
  SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM `company.billing.gcp_export_v2`
WHERE usage_start_time BETWEEN '2024-05-01' AND '2024-05-31'
  AND resource.type = 'gpu'
GROUP BY project_id, label_key;
```
Maria (Finance): Nice. After EOD send a 1-pager: root cause, who charged it, remediation steps, and recommended chargebacks. I'll approve the budget shift if Platform covers at least 60% of the overage and commits to tagging enforcement.
Leah (Platform): Preliminary numbers: ~63% of the spike from "platform-qa" untagged starters; ~23% from "rl-experiments-prod"; rest misc. We'll freeze new GPU launches to stop the burn and start an RBAC + tagging enforcement rule.
Kevin (Billing): Also flagged a vendor invoice mismatch — our committed use discount (CUD) wasn't applied for the 6/1-6/15 window. I opened a case with GCP rep (case 987654). Could change final invoice by ~$6k.
Maria (Finance): Keep the ticket link and any correspondence in the one-pager. If GCP doesn't apply the CUDs, we'll push for an invoice credit.
Ajay (Ops): FYI I pushed a small automation that prevents VM creation without required billing labels. Example create command enforced in infra PR:
```bash
gcloud compute instances create my-vm --labels=team=platform,env=qa
```
PR will be up by EOD. That should stop future untagged launches.
Leah (Platform): Thanks. Can we also enable per-team Slack budget alerts for GPU spend > $10k/week? Ops or Billing — can you set thresholds?
Kevin (Billing): I can create a temporary alert in the billing console for this month. Long-term we should wire BigQuery export to a Looker/dashboard and send automated alerts for per-team thresholds.
Maria (Finance): Agreed. Final ask for the EOD note: include list of implicated projects and whether any external/customer billables could be affected — we need to know if we must pass costs downstream.
Leah (Platform): Will attach project list and whether each is internal or customer-facing. Tagging: @Maria (Finance) @Ajay (Ops) @Kevin (Billing) :thumbsup:
Kevin (Billing): Thanks — will wait for the EOD recon. infra-bot — please close anomaly if reconciled.
infra-bot: Anomaly status: pending -> will update on manual close.
